cohort: This study involved 90 pregnant women: 30 in the control group (pregnant women with at least one previous cesarean section and a normal sited placenta) and 60 in the case group (pregnant women with at least one previous cesarean section and placenta previa with or without signs of placenta accreta).
finding: Hyperglycosylated hCG showed higher serum levels in patients with placenta accreta compared to those with placenta previa and control women.
